correctness.rationale: In the Fock normalization used in RESULT.md, the single-disk spectrum is ∫_0^R t^n e^-t/n! dt, with gap Re^-R. Coherent overlap equals s=e^-pi*d²/2. The opposite-disk coherent leakage q≤R exp(-pi(d-r_R)²) controls squared coupling to the orthogonal complement, and trace cross-bounds isolate excited states. Compression on the two coherent vectors has (ell+q±2ell s)/(1±s); Schur complement gives O(q) perturbation, q=o(s), so the stated asymptotics and spectral gap follow for every fixed R>0. Parity fixes approximate eigenvectors. Finite Galerkin quadrature is only numerical corroboration.
